programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的祕密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的祕密生活 #2
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的祕密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 #4
programme.desc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #1
programme.desc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被征服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #2
programme.desc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾羣島擁有豐富的生態系統。在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,第一批長有眼睛的動物無法分辨顏色—但隨著情況改變,無論是尋找食物、吸引配偶還是警告敵人,「看見色彩」令動物擁有很多優勢。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #1
programme.desc: 起司大師阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #2
programme.desc: 在法國,喫起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好。阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史。

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #3
programme.desc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今。

programme.title: 哈里遜福特: 好萊塢英雄
programme.desc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裏遜福。他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手。但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了。

programme.title: 拳王阿里
programme.desc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌。他的名字依舊令人尊敬。聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生。

programme.title: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
programme.desc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程。曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記……

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #1
programme.desc: 在智利托雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度。河口、濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨。

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #2
programme.desc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長。深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮游植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎。

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #3
programme.desc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族羣,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港。從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究。

programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚羣時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚羣困在其中。

programme.title: 海獵人 #2
programme.desc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。

programme.title: 海獵人 #3
programme.desc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。

programme.title: 海獵人 #4
programme.desc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚羣,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。

programme.title: 海獵人 #5
programme.desc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹羣聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。

programme.title: 海獵人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #2
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們。人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險。

programme.title: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
programme.desc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #8
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #9
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #2
programme.desc: 大衛艾登堡揭示大自然中一些最狡猾的騙子和偽裝大師。發掘一些動物如何使用顏色隱藏並消失在背景中,或是耍詭計和欺騙。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #3
programme.desc: 找出對動物顏色的科學研究背後的故事—從機械青蛙到現實世界對應物種間的角力,到蜘蛛畫眼線來吸引配偶。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #1
programme.desc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦。他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #2
programme.desc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #3
programme.desc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #4
programme.desc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈里沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區。然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #5
programme.desc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #6
programme.desc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊。

programme.title: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
programme.desc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程。曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記……

programme.title: 米高 J 福克斯: 演員樂觀活動家
programme.desc: 米高J霍士的一生,從成名到29歲被診斷出患上帕金遜症,就像一部真人秀電影,充滿了意想不到的轉折和顯著的韌性。

programme.title: 小勞勃道尼: 爬上高峯
programme.desc: 當我們想到荷里活芸芸眾多藝人時……有一個名字脫穎而出。從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報……這就是小勞勃道尼

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #2
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒: 為了嬰兒免受極端情況、飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一。從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢。

programme.title: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
programme.desc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。

programme.title: 沖繩島戰役彩色紀錄
programme.desc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。

programme.title: 發現號穿梭機的最後任務
programme.desc: 在發現號穿梭機開始最終航行前,先慶祝它非凡的過去。見證這個感情洋溢的任務,看看這架堅固但脆弱的穿梭機能否抵達首府華盛頓。

programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠。

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this special edition of the Dog Rescuers we go to Hong Kong The RSPCA doesn't just look after the welfare of dogs here in the UK, but also collaborates with parts of Europe, Asia and Africa In Hong Kong they've been working closely with local SPCA as they try to combat their ever growing stray dog population As part of an exchange programme with the UK that has been running for over a decade, Inspector Herchy Boal has come to witness and learn about those problems first hand so the two charities can work together on future solutions

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.desc: 一名叫做樂羅的可愛女孩子出現在草摩家,並揚言要見草摩夾。她的性格完全出乎小透的意料之外。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #5
programme.desc: 小透離開草摩家,搬進她親戚剛整修完工的房子裡,但是親戚卻對她極不友善。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #7
programme.desc: 為了修理茜的電腦,山田來到了她的公寓。一直以來因某些原因而刻意與女性保持距離的山田,不知為何無法將視線從午睡中的茜身上移開。就在他忍不住伸手想觸碰茜的頭髮時,玄關的門鈴突然響起。出現在門口的竟是茜的前男友拓馬,對方也對山田的存在感到詫異。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #8
programme.desc: 茜和公會成員們來到山田就讀高中的學園祭「東成祭」。瑛太和鴨田去了由學生們經營的女僕咖啡廳,琉奈則因明年將面對這所學校入學考的壓力而突然肚子痛,衝進洗手間。茜和山田決定先去購物,山田與女性在校園內同行的稀奇景象,引起周圍學生與教師的議論。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #9
programme.desc: 在學園祭上茜和山田坦誠地交流了心中的感受,變得比以前更加親近。雖然茜已經意識到自己對山田的感情,但仍對這位比自己年輕的高中生有所保留。在這股矛盾和不安的情緒中,FOS的公會有位女性新成員加入,而讓茜感到驚訝的是對方竟是山田的同班同學。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #7
programme.desc: 妮可和監志因為「好像能賺錢」這個理由而開設了上傳影片的頻道「監妮可頻道」。而守仁對於妮可和監志上傳的影片品味之差感到火大,於是向班上的同學,次文化混蛋真神圭護尋求建議。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #8
programme.desc: 監志哭著拜託守仁。原因是他一下就將家裡送來的錢花光,付不出給乙木家的生活費。於是守仁將曙乃遊樂園英雄秀的打工招募傳單遞給了監志。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #9
programme.desc: 同班同學伽羅拜託妮可「復原被碎紙機碎掉的紙屑」。然而,妮可的修復魔法「魔女恢復」必須在目標物處於完整一堆的狀態纔有效果,現在混合了各種不同的紙屑是無法使用的。伽羅表示,她想復原的是過世的母親寄給她的信。而將那封信丟入碎紙機的人正是她爸爸。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #10
programme.desc: 守仁被一羣「老套」人物組成的學生會盯上了。性感系大姊姊副會長伊武荊、關西系瞇瞇眼溫柔男副會長劍持弓弦、雙胞胎姊妹書記、天才駭客會計、野獸系無腦巨漢宣傳、精神異常系舔刀哥總務、同為總務的神祕機器人,以及右手按在帽子上不放的學生會長清宮天流。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #1
programme.desc: 威廉斯艾莉西亞在7歲的某天早晨突然驚覺,「我現在在前世玩的女性向遊戲世界裡!」。當她發現自己就是前世所嚮往的反派千金後,她決定―― 「我,要成為名留歷史的壞女人!」

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #2
programme.desc: 為了成為名留歷史的壞女人,艾莉西亞每日勤奮不懈,不僅努力追求知識,也重視在實地的親見親聞,她因而前往被魔法隔離的羅亞納村。沒想到在當地等著她的是足以左右她人生的一場相遇!

programme.title: 海賊王 #25
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 為了修理茜的電腦,山田來到了她的公寓。一直以來因某些原因而刻意與女性保持距離的山田,不知為何無法將視線從午睡中的茜身上移開。就在他忍不住伸手想觸碰茜的頭髮時,玄關的門鈴突然響起。出現在門口的竟是茜的前男友拓馬,對方也對山田的存在感到詫異。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #8
programme.desc: 茜和公會成員們來到山田就讀高中的學園祭「東成祭」。瑛太和鴨田去了由學生們經營的女僕咖啡廳,琉奈則因明年將面對這所學校入學考的壓力而突然肚子痛,衝進洗手間。茜和山田決定先去購物,山田與女性在校園內同行的稀奇景象,引起周圍學生與教師的議論。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #9
programme.desc: 在學園祭上茜和山田坦誠地交流了心中的感受,變得比以前更加親近。雖然茜已經意識到自己對山田的感情,但仍對這位比自己年輕的高中生有所保留。在這股矛盾和不安的情緒中,FOS的公會有位女性新成員加入,而讓茜感到驚訝的是對方竟是山田的同班同學。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #7
programme.desc: 妮可和監志因為「好像能賺錢」這個理由而開設了上傳影片的頻道「監妮可頻道」。而守仁對於妮可和監志上傳的影片品味之差感到火大,於是向班上的同學,次文化混蛋真神圭護尋求建議。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #8
programme.desc: 監志哭著拜託守仁。原因是他一下就將家裡送來的錢花光,付不出給乙木家的生活費。於是守仁將曙乃遊樂園英雄秀的打工招募傳單遞給了監志。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #9
programme.desc: 同班同學伽羅拜託妮可「復原被碎紙機碎掉的紙屑」。然而,妮可的修復魔法「魔女恢復」必須在目標物處於完整一堆的狀態纔有效果,現在混合了各種不同的紙屑是無法使用的。伽羅表示,她想復原的是過世的母親寄給她的信。而將那封信丟入碎紙機的人正是她爸爸。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #10
programme.desc: 守仁被一羣「老套」人物組成的學生會盯上了。性感系大姊姊副會長伊武荊、關西系瞇瞇眼溫柔男副會長劍持弓弦、雙胞胎姊妹書記、天才駭客會計、野獸系無腦巨漢宣傳、精神異常系舔刀哥總務、同為總務的神祕機器人,以及右手按在帽子上不放的學生會長清宮天流。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #10
programme.desc: 在茜因為嚴重的感冒差點倒下時,出現在她面前的山田把她送到診所看病。椿曾在另一款網路遊戲中與山田對戰,與他建立友誼。瞭解山田會與女性保持距離的椿儘管心中排斥喜歡上對方,但對他的感情卻逐漸變得深厚,山田在她心中的地位也日益增大。

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #5
programme.desc: 由於烈核解放,可瑪莉擊退了米莉桑德,卻喪失一切記憶,仍然對自己的強大實力毫無自覺。這時可瑪莉巧遇七紅天之一的芙萊特,當場發生衝突。之後皇帝下令可瑪莉擊退恐怖分子,而被選為她的搭檔的,是明明身為七紅天,卻內向又嬌弱的少女——佐久奈!

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #6
programme.desc: 為了判定可瑪莉配不配當七紅天,召開了七紅天會議。芙萊特懷疑可瑪莉的實力,抓到機會就開口攻擊,可瑪莉反嗆回去,會議現場一片混亂。暴怒的芙萊特正式向可瑪莉宣戰,但是武鬥派的奧迪隆竟乾脆提議直接舉辦七紅天互相廝殺的「七紅天爭霸戰」!

programme.title: 海賊王 #27
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #5

programme.title: 海賊王女 #6
programme.desc: 被關在採掘場的雪丸等人試圖逃脫,追上遭火爆玫瑰抓住的菲娜。而菲娜被帶往阿貝爾率領的英國海兵隊軍船。阿貝爾將她帶到客房後講述了哥布林劍士以及菲娜母親的事,她同時也得知武士們真正的目的。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 打工仔「為錢幣做奴隸」的歌詞唱出基層心聲，諺語「受人二分四」出處亦與錢幣有關！幾仙「辰砂」隨時升值變成價值不菲的古董，收藏家逐一分享私人珍藏。放高利貸人士是否必定「耳窿大」？典當大押在香港曾相當流行，財困客人為何要請當舖掌櫃喫「燉蛋」？現代「二叔公」憶述當年鬧市「趕綿羊」奇景。主持到訪懷舊主題茶餐廳，竟可找到在大型遊樂場留下的兒時回憶。今回亦瞭解順口又㜺鬼，還蘊藏豐富人生哲理的「念口簧」式民謠。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 獅頭紥作師傅巧製威武成品，滿足到顧客要求便感高興，當然不覺自己「獅子捉老鼠－ 大材小用」！「打乞嗤」與被掛念、被咒罵有關？說法竟源於二、三千年前！語言學者錢志安「冇事冇幹」翻看粵語長片，原來是為解構五十、六十年代經典地道用語。港人創意無限，汽水蓋也可變成開埠早年的兒時恩物，鄭寶鴻細說「荷蘭水蓋」歷史。所謂「滾水泡茶－ 又濃又香」，茗茶文化博大精深。何浩文加入主持行列，向茶莊老闆請教茶葉加工祕訣。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 主持在馬灣尋十隻貪玩野獸參與遊戲。根據經驗，特玩隊一定輸？楊潮凱認為與翟威廉同組纔是真正原因！簡單只用派對紙條響哨作遊戲，當對手吹響聲時用口一咬，阻止對方得分，陳嘉桓要投訴林希靈玩得太恐怖！經典「大電視」遊戲出場，為何每條題目都是在形容翟威廉？何浩文見到甚麼而變得木無表情？出線遊戲「乒乓層層疊」，大玩隊在兩分鐘內便完成，特玩隊由威廉接最後一棒，單單是這一棒已花兩分鐘。看來潮凱的說法不幸言中。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 上陣不離父子兵的畢德利和巴尼再上路探險。今次目標是天氣和暖的拉丁美洲。第一站是墨西哥。此程活動包括乘坐熱氣球升空、和職業摔角手一較高下、觀賞一些怪娃娃、並走上挑戰極大的登山鐵道。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼繼續墨西哥之旅。完成艱苦的鐵索棧道之後，他們向西南方進發，前去馬雅文明發源地尤卡坦半島。他們去蝙蝠洞觀光，希望看到難得一見的蛇吞蝙蝠奇景，又訪問太陽劇團，向雜技藝人學習。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 雖然黛雅成功獲救，但與此同時，Bug Bug蟲卻佔領了星夢頻道衛星，並且讓衛星朝著閃亮宿方向墜落。黛雅嘗試阻止，卻被Bug Bug蟲阻撓，無法接近衛星的安全系統，星夢頻道偶像能否解救這個危機呢?!

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 是日母親節，多啦A夢見大雄只是摘了蒲公英送給媽媽，便用「體貼長槍」讓媽媽倍感受到關懷。多啦A夢患感冒，多啦美留了藥水給他，誰知有人誤把「聲音凝固劑」當作藥水吞服，結果弄得一團亂。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 開始進行新歌封面設計的14名B-PRO成員各自提出不同想法，讓翼整天盯著行程和預算煩惱。Ultras運用一直以來的專長自行創作，在公司裡得到很高評價，但好景不常，Ultras在一次直播中竟拍攝到封面草圖的檔案夾。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 主持們再次發掘上海文青小街，來到人氣美食集中地愚園路，邊嚐巨型法式葡撻，邊賞令人舒暢的油菜花田，Chill爆。在魔都尋訪正宗關東煮，以火龍果蜜桃酒沙瓦伴鍋物，味道添上清新。糖妹、婭溦光顧網紅小店，紅絲絨草莓三文治、芒果巧克力三文治，味蕾有福。必到日式甜品店，多款蛋糕、麻糬入手！特大酥皮手槍雞腿包，還需集兩位主持之力鯨吞咀嚼，份量驚人！夜深，她們還在紀錄片體驗店開餐，口腹感受滿桌「擼串」文化！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 雞髀菇含有豐富膳食纖維，肥媽以全新方法主理「手撕雞髀菇」，發揮創意煮出新穎口感滋味。她另採用冬菇、蝦仁、雞肉等食材伴以苦瓜烹調，令口味甘苦的健康食材變得平易近人。南乳的營養價值不容忽視，阿媽將傳統「南乳炸雞翼」加以改良，用油更少喫得更健康。湯水「沙參玉竹螺頭燉野鴿」用料十足，清甜可口而且具有養陰清肺功效。此外，6號於今集亦前往食品店見識被稱為「夢幻神奇菇」的繡球菌，以及瞭解不同品種的新鮮玉竹。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號外出搜羅枇杷花等中藥食材孝敬肥媽，還獲魚檔靚姐給予「買一送一」優惠，購入大魚和鯇魚的魚鰾。阿媽炮製一道「薑蔥砂鍋魚鰾」，並分享去除魚鰾腥味的祕訣；另奉上味道濃鬱的「枇杷花水鴨��花果湯」，有助滋陰進補。二人突然上演「廚房劍擊」，究竟發生何事？阿媽及後讓6號主理「蝦乾炒蒜心」，他卻假手於「自動炒煮機」，還笑言「小學雞都識煮」！雞胸肉要炸出脆嫩口感？留意肥媽用蛋白、魚露等醃製雞胸，帶來「蜜汁雞球」。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿接下挑戰任務，要成為「仁濟」慈善直播騷監製，夢想有全女班幕後班底，但現實總是充滿不可能！一眾藝員「轉職」幕後，事前對創製不同崗位的認識有幾深？趁有其他慈善騷綵排，導演賴慰玲、助導程浩駿、關楓馨深入一廠控制室偷師，及後卻認定任務不可能！至於負責撰稿的戴祖儀、李芷晴、梁超怡則到機構轄下設施做資料蒐集，沒有紙筆記下重點的她們，感覺更像藝人探訪。眾人於賣橋會議意見多多，卻換來節目策劃高層皺着眉離開？

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 賣橋會議後，監製諾懿對團隊「黑麪」，唯盼大家可切實構思好節目方向。或許對創製崗位未太熟識，眾人先上「雞精班」認清撰稿、助導的日常工作與要求。向仁濟一方匯報構思，機構代表聽後竟然講抱歉？這句開場白令諾懿大感壓力，幸好最終獲讚！「導演」慰玲、「助導」楓馨、「撰稿」芷晴出發進行外景拍攝，到達場地後，楓馨卻被攝影師怒視，究竟她犯了甚麼「死罪」？拍外景常有突發事，場地代表阻止拍攝，慰玲如何引領團隊解決問題？

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵
programme.desc: 怡保「芯」度行啟程，黎諾懿相約首集嘉賓李佳芯遊二奶巷掃街，還找到數年前與店家的合照？百年藥材店轉型茶室，兩人獲老闆招待，細味茶文化。木工廠成小朋友樂園，達人手製木造玩具送給大家！佳芯重拾童趣，也意外顯露「老靈魂」？坐小船穿過山洞，迎來世外桃源般的鏡湖祕景，用心感受大自然的純粹。佳芯歎白咖啡順道學拉茶啡，諾懿卻彈到二樓「食花生」；咖央多士一啖一牛油，好邪惡！接着深入鄉郊的榴槤樹屋，享受片刻恬靜時光。

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓劉穎鏇初次踏足馬來西亞，想瘋狂歎美食，卻被帶到羅京森林……尋找「世界最大之花」大王花，諾懿背起穎鏇涉水渡河，說好的悠閒之旅呢？金馬崙高原是避暑勝地，穎鏇體驗餵羊與趕羊，卻遭無視？諾懿更被草泥馬口水突襲！走進夢幻花海打卡，再DIY微型生態盆栽，好療癒！豪華營地內的全透明「水晶房」，觀星住宿之選。嚐過士多啤梨雞飯後，二人行逛夜市感受地道風情。返回營區繼續食，好友圍爐自製番薯糖水，回顧旅程深刻點滴。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 不論學做甜品還是學習演戲，在名師指導下當然事半功倍。何廣沛專誠來向阿古(古嘉俊)拜師，透過學做「檸檬開心果朱古力粒」，領略甜品製作竅門。檸檬汁的酸性會與鮮奶產生化學作用，本來不宜作為朱古力材料，到底阿古有何方法將檸檬芳香融入朱古力？自家製開心果醬不但口味獨特，翠緣顏色還令何廣沛聯想到日式芥辣。原來阿古亦曾以日式芥辣製作甜品，他在節目中分享有趣經驗。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴因適性值不足未能參戰，加上良太和茜的冷言冷語，終於忍不住一走了之。太晴躲進元宇宙之中，詎料伊奈突然出現，更邀請太晴與她一起摧毀超鐵機。太晴察覺不妥並拒絕，其後伊奈向超鐵機正式宣戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 揚琴是中國一種傳統擊弦樂器，演奏時以琴竹敲擊琴絃發聲，音色清脆悅耳。本集「My Little Show」，一位女生帶來揚琴獨奏，值得細心聆聽。另有六位小女孩手持豬仔錢罌登場，送上充滿童趣的芭蕾舞表演。此外，主持姐姐、女結他導師合唱<星星的加冕和<家有小熊兩首「童話與夢想之歌」。她們在交流中談及兒時的勇敢行為與夢想，瀅仴姐姐分享自己成功實現成為演員的心願。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 著名設計師黑鷲久美子舉辦時裝表演，惟屬於重頭戲的公主蛋頭冠卻離奇消失，屁屁偵探應邀去協助調查，卻發現警官數量甚少，原來久美子拒絕報警，屁屁偵探從久美子與模特兒的對話發現案情不單純。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在電視上看到有車輪的行李箱，覺得很新奇，爺爺向英叔借了回來，兩人籌備去旅行。姐姐遺失了和良子同學一起造的扣針，遍尋不獲，野口教小丸子把失物倒轉來唸，便有可能把失物尋回。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 危機現場粵
programme.desc: 本片選取近年來國內最具代表性的安全事故和自然災害，作科學分析，重現處置過程，展現當下中國應急救援專業能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事發原因和調查過程，解讀事故隱患。同時，展示人類的勇氣、智慧與無畏。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 近年香港的士行業迎來「新血」，運輸署資料顯示，截至2025年10月，40歲或以下持牌司機增加至182萬人，較2019年顯著上升五成四。這羣年輕司機，大多追求彈性工時，以及多勞多得的收入結構。當中部分人組成車隊，透過社交媒體，積極開拓新市場；也有人成為「的士打理人」，承擔十多部的士的管理責任。他們會為行業帶來甚麼新氣象？在過程中，又會面對甚麼困難？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 購物平臺用戶發現帳戶離奇遭盜用，5天內瘋狂下單6次購入逾萬元貨物，立即聯絡平臺，能否成功攔截取消訂單？視後佘詩曼現身宣傳新劇《正義女神》，吸引大批劇迷撐場！「靚聲王」胡鴻鈞喜獲粉絲大搞慶生派對。運輸署推出新措施，4月1日起，全港的士必須提供至少兩種電子繳費媒介。20年前，慈母為助抽中居屋的兒子置業，不惜與丈夫、胞弟傾盡積蓄；20年後，三老又為財困兒子賣樓，驚悉物業已被「釘契」，背後竟疑是奪產陰謀？

programme.title: 香港何濟公止痛退熱散呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 「黑白榮耀換位賽」，翻出第二章。上一集，「上弦黑隊」全員成功守住寶座，本集五回對決中，「下弦白隊」可會有人能夠「反Cup」？而掉進「危險區」的五位選手，究竟哪兩人即將告別「中4」舞臺？

programme.title: 一週星星粵
programme.desc: 遊戲節目《唱錢》引來網絡熱話，主持兼音樂總監Eric Kwok更為相關評分系統付出極大心力！太太葉佩雯於「你問我答」拍片提問，想知Eric突然不怕蟑螂的原因。說起太太，《唱錢》另一主持森美當年瞞婚，為何近年不介意多談家庭事？身邊朋友常聽森美提到會退休，究竟幾時才退？另外，對於被指在作曲方面江郎才盡，Eric坦言對作曲的興趣有所減退，其中一個原因是多了XiX經理人的身分，還自揭並非主動提出要任此職！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 行仔與鼎爺到訪星廚主理的私房菜館，品嚐以法式吊湯方式烹調的羊肚菌清雞湯、內藏「佛跳牆」的炸子雞，極富心思。居港瑞士廚師帶暉哥享用正宗瑞士菜，包括傳統芝士火鍋、蘇黎世式牛仔肉等佳餚，並細說瑞士飲食文化。行仔再與伍倩彤到大澳「掃街」，遍嚐即炸沙翁、蝦醬豬肉捲餅、炭燒黃花魚春及瀨尿蝦乾，別具風味。尖沙咀一間24小時營業的食店，復刻昔日車仔檔的沙嗲風味，燒鴨絲沙嗲米通粉、沙嗲小食拼盤，皆是宵夜好選擇。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
疊影狙擊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 忠仔突然身亡，晟傑讓曉晨向Green World成員套話，Tina向曉晨承認他們在工地的水泥袋裡發現很多錢，懷疑新領域集團走私黑錢。忠仔因缺錢，半夜到工地偷錢，極可能因此遇害。文諾看到忠仔的新聞，安排霆釗進行下一步行動。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 購物平臺用戶發現帳戶離奇遭盜用，5天內瘋狂下單6次購入逾萬元貨物，立即聯絡平臺，能否成功攔截取消訂單？視後佘詩曼現身宣傳新劇《正義女神》，吸引大批劇迷撐場！「靚聲王」胡鴻鈞喜獲粉絲大搞慶生派對。運輸署推出新措施，4月1日起，全港的士必須提供至少兩種電子繳費媒介。20年前，慈母為助抽中居屋的兒子置業，不惜與丈夫、胞弟傾盡積蓄；20年後，三老又為財困兒子賣樓，驚悉物業已被「釘契」，背後竟疑是奪產陰謀？

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿接下挑戰任務，要成為「仁濟」慈善直播騷監製，夢想有全女班幕後班底，但現實總是充滿不可能！一眾藝員「轉職」幕後，事前對創製不同崗位的認識有幾深？趁有其他慈善騷綵排，導演賴慰玲、助導程浩駿、關楓馨深入一廠控制室偷師，及後卻認定任務不可能！至於負責撰稿的戴祖儀、李芷晴、梁超怡則到機構轄下設施做資料蒐集，沒有紙筆記下重點的她們，感覺更像藝人探訪。眾人於賣橋會議意見多多，卻換來節目策劃高層皺着眉離開？

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 賣橋會議後，監製諾懿對團隊「黑麪」，唯盼大家可切實構思好節目方向。或許對創製崗位未太熟識，眾人先上「雞精班」認清撰稿、助導的日常工作與要求。向仁濟一方匯報構思，機構代表聽後竟然講抱歉？這句開場白令諾懿大感壓力，幸好最終獲讚！「導演」慰玲、「助導」楓馨、「撰稿」芷晴出發進行外景拍攝，到達場地後，楓馨卻被攝影師怒視，究竟她犯了甚麼「死罪」？拍外景常有突發事，場地代表阻止拍攝，慰玲如何引領團隊解決問題？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 親近動物有不少方法，這趟旅程會多角度展示。從小已怕動物的慰玲猜拳輸了要餵羊駝，竟被牠嚇至跌倒，還驚到喊。朱仔首次騎馬後，形容似「坐過山車」，一邊騎馬，一邊亦可欣賞戶外駿域谷的美景。主持們還乘坐馬車遊覽，振朗卻差點被拋出車外。深入遠離悉尼市區的獵人谷，先到百年歷史的酒窖品酒，加上朱古力Pairing就更出眾？其後，三位好友安躺草地看日落，細談「浪漫的定義」。而慰玲心目中的浪漫，竟只是一句話這般簡單？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 繼續暢遊獵人谷，主持們在戶外學造朱古力；朱仔嘗試追女仔慘「食檸檬」，只好向男拍檔出手？玩電動平衡車時，振朗被慰玲「嫌廢」。在邦迪海灘開心踏浪，怎料眾人最終濕身收場！清晨五時，大家劃獨木舟出海看日出。「鹹蛋黃」初升之際，畫面卻令幕後人員崩潰，究竟發生何事？振朗及後更模仿蔡思貝發聲控訴？在酒吧喝着雞尾酒聚話，節目組準備了情感問題，讓三人來一趟深情對話。當要向身旁好友說出心底話，振朗、慰玲更雙雙落淚……

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 不論學做甜品還是學習演戲，在名師指導下當然事半功倍。何廣沛專誠來向阿古(古嘉俊)拜師，透過學做「檸檬開心果朱古力粒」，領略甜品製作竅門。檸檬汁的酸性會與鮮奶產生化學作用，本來不宜作為朱古力材料，到底阿古有何方法將檸檬芳香融入朱古力？自家製開心果醬不但口味獨特，翠緣顏色還令何廣沛聯想到日式芥辣。原來阿古亦曾以日式芥辣製作甜品，他在節目中分享有趣經驗。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 轉轉口味，糖妹、婭溦這集來到上海的韓國街，化身「韓妹」遍尋韓式小喫。快餐車直送芝士香腸熱狗、奶油年糕湯。未夠滋味？幫襯出爐熱辣辣核桃餅與咖啡豆餅。炭燒烤肉風味大餐開動！厚切豬五花棒棒糖、豬豬星球拼盤，還不及火豚星三拼飯邪惡！大口吞下韓國的味道，難怪婭溦要點喝清腸排毒果汁。主持們換上漢服，置身格調優雅的文化茶館，在城市中的世外桃源歇一歇息。入夜，全力衝刺全蟹宴私房菜，婭溦帶來獨門拌蟹麵喫法！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 雞髀菇含有豐富膳食纖維，肥媽以全新方法主理「手撕雞髀菇」，發揮創意煮出新穎口感滋味。她另採用冬菇、蝦仁、雞肉等食材伴以苦瓜烹調，令口味甘苦的健康食材變得平易近人。南乳的營養價值不容忽視，阿媽將傳統「南乳炸雞翼」加以改良，用油更少喫得更健康。湯水「沙參玉竹螺頭燉野鴿」用料十足，清甜可口而且具有養陰清肺功效。此外，6號於今集亦前往食品店見識被稱為「夢幻神奇菇」的繡球菌，以及瞭解不同品種的新鮮玉竹。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號外出搜羅枇杷花等中藥食材孝敬肥媽，還獲魚檔靚姐給予「買一送一」優惠，購入大魚和鯇魚的魚鰾。阿媽炮製一道「薑蔥砂鍋魚鰾」，並分享去除魚鰾腥味的祕訣；另奉上味道濃鬱的「枇杷花水鴨紫花果湯」，有助滋陰進補。二人突然上演「廚房劍擊」，究竟發生何事？阿媽及後讓6號主理「蝦乾炒蒜心」，他卻假手於「自動炒煮機」，還笑言「小學雞都識煮」！雞胸肉要炸出脆嫩口感？留意肥媽用蛋白、魚露等醃製雞胸，帶來「蜜汁雞球」。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 上陣不離父子兵的畢德利和巴尼再上路探險。今次目標是天氣和暖的拉丁美洲。第一站是墨西哥。此程活動包括乘坐熱氣球升空、和職業摔角手一較高下、觀賞一些怪娃娃、並走上挑戰極大的登山鐵道。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼繼續墨西哥之旅。完成艱苦的鐵索棧道之後，他們向西南方進發，前去馬雅文明發源地尤卡坦半島。他們去蝙蝠洞觀光，希望看到難得一見的蛇吞蝙蝠奇景，又訪問太陽劇團，向雜技藝人學習。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#64粵
programme.desc: 朋指悅教壞女兒，夫妻進入冷戰狀態。悅更為此搬到隔壁與情同牀，朋卻愛理不理。悅氣憤難消，竟要搬到賓館居住，但悅所住的賓館位於龍蛇混雜之地，衛生環境差勁，令不懂世事的悅苦不堪言，翌日悅發覺賓館已改頭換面。

programme.title: 尚食#4粵普
programme.desc: 殷紫萍想用繩子勒死子衿，幸子衿反應快沒讓她得逞；子衿在錦衣衛等眾人面前與老媽子對質，讓錦衣衛倖然而去；紫萍對子衿說出身世讓門外的人聽去，且報告予孟紫澐；朱瞻基有輕微中毒反應，他對下毒的人心裡有數。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 廚餘都可成為美食，鼎爺與阿譚到魚蛋店，見識炸魚皮的整個工序。雲吞皮能夠煲糖水，也可幻化成「片兒麵」這種懷舊小食。鼎爺明明要做「火雞片兒麵」，為何不見有火雞？這碗片兒麵的精髓是雞湯，而調製「皮水」的糖、醋、水的比例則要拿得準繩。鼎爺接着為田雞腿去骨，再加入不少料頭及白玉苦瓜燜煮，出爐菜式「啖啖肉」！還有甜品水果大菜糕，選用水果並非喜愛即可，也要顧及味道與顏色。此外，要加強降火效用，可再加入甚麼材料？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 家族性腺瘤性瘜肉症(FAP)是一種基因突變引起的遺傳病，大腸內會長出成百上千顆腺瘤性瘜肉，外科專科醫生指出定會演變成腸癌，亦會影響其他器官？醫生建議患者接受預防性全大腸切除手術，可望徹底解決問題。烹飪節目《轟炸味蕾的廚房》主持區永權、戴祖儀到來，暢談拍攝點滴。兩人也向大王形容喫過的美食，零入廚經驗的祖儀更因節目想嘗試下廚？「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「番茄煮魚」，用罐頭番茄可能比新鮮番茄更好？

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 在汕頭，似乎甚麼食材都可用來製作粿品，祖藍學習造粿，脫模的臨門一腳卻有甩漏！他亦即場試喫蒸粿與煎粿的分別。潮汕牛肉火鍋可謂火鍋界的「天花板」，不同刁鑽部位也可嚐到；店家附上淥煮時間參考，祖藍偏偏不愛跟。他還「火雞姐」上身，試打牛丸，累透了，唯有多喫一點補充體力，牛肉確實夠新鮮！汕頭甜湯即香港的糖水，傳統上有何款式可選？交由老闆娘親自推薦。作為「潮」店當然亦有創新選擇，鹹蛋與菠菜也跟甜品扯上關係？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#16粵

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.desc: Rebecca與張龍分手後，若水等人察覺她有不妥，住所更淪為「恐怖屋」。原來她身心俱疲，不願處理工作以外之事，眾人於是代為分擔。另一方面，Rebecca接到不少帳單，卻懶於理會，而若水等人亦厭煩繁瑣事項。Sam等人舉辦聚會，互相幫忙處理生活瑣事，若水等遂仿傚舉辦「行政之夜」，成效顯著。為免Rebecca睹物思人，眾人落力清理各種跟張龍有關的物品，並代為處理相關麻煩事務，Rebecca卻有事相瞞……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#1粵PG
programme.desc: 某天台遊樂場發生一宗悲劇，八歲小童胡宇澤墮樓身亡，而年僅十四歲、殿堂級大狀高淑樺之子高成彬被控謀殺，案件轟動全城，主審正是言惠知法官。高等法院常任法官陳官舉行榮休晚會，準備宣佈由惠知接任，卻因惠知的負面傳聞而需要暫緩。成彬由緘默改為選擇答辯，淑樺申請延後審訊尋找更多證據，惠知批准；惠知這決定，被其在律政司任職的丈夫邱光正認為過於冒險。正當一切塵埃落定，惠知準備晉升的宣誓之際，卻接到一個震撼的消息！

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#18粵普PG
programme.desc: 景翊搜出木質官印，揭穿江到海偽造官印，高羅遷被控以毒藥脅迫官員。皇帝命瑾瑜赴交州查看情況，柳世江返交州後失蹤，屍體在竹林被尋獲，並身插竹筍，周遭毒蟲拼出讖言；仵作初判為意外，楚楚主張解剖卻遭韓績阻撓。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵

programme.title: 高朋滿座#64粵

programme.title: 尚食#4粵普
programme.desc: 殷紫萍想用繩子勒死子衿，幸子衿反應快沒讓她得逞；子衿在錦衣衛等眾人面前與老媽子對質，讓錦衣衛倖然而去；紫萍對子衿說出身世讓門外的人聽去，且報告予孟紫澐；朱瞻基有輕微中毒反應，他對下毒的人心裡有數。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#65粵
programme.desc: 朋與悅雖然決裂，但仍很關心婷的學業，更在人前假扮恩愛。父母吵架令婷不願留家，言行亦變得粗俗，慶發覺婷與壞朋友來往。有朋誤會蕙婷遭人禁錮，迎接三位大漢的挑戰。夫妻竟然因此而和好，卻不知他們是「入錯房」。

programme.title: 尚食#5粵普
programme.desc: 姚子衿在宮中偶遇朱瞻基，讓她回想起兒時第一次見到他的情景，她甚至在送餐過去時悄悄觀察他的臥室。太子妃辦賞花會，郭側妃提議藉此進行典廚比賽。殷紫萍得知太子妃心儀豆腐，故以豆腐入饌，希望得到太子妃賞識。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺從芸芸花膠款式中，選用較細小的鴨泡膠代替雲吞皮製作「花膠雲吞」，留意他示範處理細薄花膠的方法。為何鼎爺選用五花腩製作餡料？釀入餡料後用韭菜紮起頭尾再蒸熟，精緻雲吞配香濃上湯或上湯蠔油芡，同樣美味！再看鼎爺怎樣處理豬脷，將豬脷切片配上醒胃的話梅蒸香，話梅的鹹香令菜式錦上添花。他接着利用雞蛋殼炮製「三色蛋」，先在雞蛋殼開小洞，然後加入蒸熟的皮蛋與鹹蛋粒，再倒進蛋白蒸熟。想成品美觀又嫩滑，有何祕技？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺結節雖大多屬良性，但仍有機會演變為肺癌。呼吸系統科醫生細述結合內窺鏡與導航技術的診斷新方法，並介紹新型的肺結節消融術，都有助減低病人接受治療時的痛楚與風險。鄧達智又帶大王、秀怡外出覓食，走進英式懷舊風格餐廳，先享用豐盛的英式全日早餐，再推介經典法式洋蔥湯、招牌炸雞與油封鴨腿。最後以火焰雪山甜品作結，冰火交融，儀式感滿滿。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐選用時令的香椿菜，帶來營養豐富的「蝦蓉香椿菜煎蛋」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍學到這集的關鍵潮汕話「雜雜落」，即甚麼款式都有之意，一於跟他食盡各式汕頭宵夜美食。珠江路美食街一間乾麵店，明明乾麵纔是主角，「配角」一碗湯卻有齊豬肉、豬雜、海鮮、丸子？難怪獲攝製組選為冠軍美饌。鑽入民居區，有間夫妻檔餃子店，祖藍點了「雜雜落」的餃子，喫來竟似在開盲盒！他一直期待的芒光餃，卻留守至最後才讓他喫到，究竟芒光是何食材？喫雜錦水果解膩，祖藍奇怪是「鹹鹹的」，原來是甘草在作怪！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#17粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒嵐懷孕，兆明勤奮打理家務。力奇、喜詩和菲兒有意結束咖啡店，司徒嵐反對。鄧勤知道曉盈使計令蔣生凍結他的冷壓果汁計劃，也揭穿曉盈用詭計令德正陷入困境。酒醉德正向丹丹傾訴心事，透露為了美娜將股份賣給百喜昇。曉盈代表百喜昇接手管理鼎福和，提出人事和生產線變動，更終止兆明的顧問合約。兆明鬱悶回到村口，司徒嵐走上車雀躍地道出小說結局，一輛貨櫃車突然失控撞來。二人送院搶救，司徒嵐昏迷不醒更發現腦內有瘀血……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: TRIGGER在雨中進行街頭表演，有人駐足觀賞，亦有人不顧而去。聽見粉絲支持的聲音，天深受感動，忍不住當眾流淚。一織分析陸人氣急升的原因，發現關鍵在於其驚人的訴求力，並擔心有朝一日會不受控制。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐在其他人面前隱藏實力，令蜻蛉大為不滿，更罵他是騙子，此事令五十嵐想起自己過往曾冷待兒子，導致對方放棄打高爾夫球。五十嵐把蜻蛉父親留下的握把換到挖起桿上，成功吸引她試用挖起桿。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 膀胱癌是泌尿系統其中一種常見的惡性腫瘤，吸煙是最主要的發病因素，63歲的黃先生吸煙多年，約兩年前的一日突然小便痛，伴隨血水，看醫生服了一星期紓緩藥都沒用，之後看第二位醫生確診膀胱癌，切除了4釐米的腫瘤後，再覆診時，醫生說要全切除膀胱再重建假膀胱，手術後黃先生休息了三個月便復工，不用服藥，現時每半年覆診一次。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2775粵
programme.desc: 講真話隨時會惹麻煩！面對應否直言的情況，樹根經常騙他人代勞以解決問題。為了躲懶並避免惹禍，樹根設法讓瑞素代他向Bonnie提出修改對白極長的某場戲，怎料生出變故。樹根遂說謊騙力王代勞，力王因此得罪Bonnie。其後，家聰發現力王常被樹根利用代為發聲，淪為代罪羔羊，遂打算替力王出氣。後來，樹根一反常態，不能自控地直言實話，得罪人之外，更有洩露祕密的危機，不禁心慌……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#2粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知趕往現場，目睹宇澤的母親蘇麗慈持刀挾持成彬，事態逐漸失控……一年後，惠知放棄升職，主動調遷少年法庭，更因此與光正離婚。工作嚴謹的惠知，與輕鬆的裁判法院法官們格格不入。海濱公園內，滿身鮮血的姚振銘，向路經的裁判官鄭邵文稱砍傷了姊姊和妹妹。父親認定振銘是妒忌姊姊得到偏愛而犯案，辯方律師程睿燊以振銘有精神問題抗辯。感化官鄭邵玲認為振銘的姊弟關係其實不錯，惠知要求邵文上庭作證，讓振銘道出真相……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#19粵普PG
programme.desc: 楚楚在柳世江屍體旁發現毒蟲卵殼，檢查後確認毒蟲是在其體內生長。楚楚試探玉瀾，玉瀾反應激烈。瑾瑜將柳世江死因告知韓績，問他與玉瀾關係。陸續有百姓失蹤，瑾瑜推測與毒蟲之事有關，便引蛇出洞找出毒營所在。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 遼寧大連的海鮮夠肥美，螻蛄蝦被指有陣似洗衣粉的土腥味？世韜師傅這次選用平民價的大連鮮鮑魚，並以青花椒油、泡椒、鹹酸菜做湯底，煮出香濃的「酸菜鮑魚」。主持區永權見鮑魚煮至五成熟即關火，曾感懷疑，喫後卻大讚這做法！四川青神縣是「椪柑之鄉」，用柑、椒等蔬果可炮製甚麼美食？錄影廠內，創意廚師譚詠儀師傅轉用青檸及其汁，製作蔥味冷盤「涼拌青檸豬手」！豬手用凍水汆水、浸煮一小時再浸冰水，偏多的工序有何實際功用？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#35粵
programme.desc: 少龍被封「護國上將軍」，往蕞城迎擊趙軍。善柔與廷芳喬裝夫妻，在渡頭要求歌舞團班主鳳姐的船載二人到齊國。團中臺柱鳳菲一聲不響嫁人，鳳姐發現廷芳貌似鳳菲，決定由她假扮鳳菲表演。不韋以東郡民變要求派王翦先往平亂，再趕往蕞城，嬴政無奈答允。李牧相約少龍城樓外會面痛飲，從此恩斷義絕。少龍項正擔心王翦的援軍未到，一羣墨者來相助守城，豈料卻倒戈相向。少嬴政知道蕞城失守，少龍生死未卜，猶如五雷轟頂。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肺結節雖大多屬良性，但仍有機會演變為肺癌。呼吸系統科醫生細述結合內窺鏡與導航技術的診斷新方法，並介紹新型的肺結節消融術，都有助減低病人接受治療時的痛楚與風險。鄧達智又帶大王、秀怡外出覓食，走進英式懷舊風格餐廳，先享用豐盛的英式全日早餐，再推介經典法式洋蔥湯、招牌炸雞與油封鴨腿。最後以火焰雪山甜品作結，冰火交融，儀式感滿滿。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐選用時令的香椿菜，帶來營養豐富的「蝦蓉香椿菜煎蛋」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍學到這集的關鍵潮汕話「雜雜落」，即甚麼款式都有之意，一於跟他食盡各式汕頭宵夜美食。珠江路美食街一間乾麵店，明明乾麵纔是主角，「配角」一碗湯卻有齊豬肉、豬雜、海鮮、丸子？難怪獲攝製組選為冠軍美饌。鑽入民居區，有間夫妻檔餃子店，祖藍點了「雜雜落」的餃子，喫來竟似在開盲盒！他一直期待的芒光餃，卻留守至最後才讓他喫到，究竟芒光是何食材？喫雜錦水果解膩，祖藍奇怪是「鹹鹹的」，原來是甘草在作怪！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#17粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒嵐懷孕，兆明勤奮打理家務。力奇、喜詩和菲兒有意結束咖啡店，司徒嵐反對。鄧勤知道曉盈使計令蔣生凍結他的冷壓果汁計劃，也揭穿曉盈用詭計令德正陷入困境。酒醉德正向丹丹傾訴心事，透露為了美娜將股份賣給百喜昇。曉盈代表百喜昇接手管理鼎福和，提出人事和生產線變動，更終止兆明的顧問合約。兆明鬱悶回到村口，司徒嵐走上車雀躍地道出小說結局，一輛貨櫃車突然失控撞來。二人送院搶救，司徒嵐昏迷不醒更發現腦內有瘀血……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#65粵
programme.desc: 朋與悅雖然決裂，但仍很關心婷的學業，更在人前假扮恩愛。父母吵架令婷不願留家，言行亦變得粗俗，慶發覺婷與壞朋友來往。有朋誤會蕙婷遭人禁錮，迎接三位大漢的挑戰。夫妻竟然因此而和好，卻不知他們是「入錯房」。

programme.title: 尚食#5粵普
programme.desc: 姚子衿在宮中偶遇朱瞻基，讓她回想起兒時第一次見到他的情景，她甚至在送餐過去時悄悄觀察他的臥室。太子妃辦賞花會，郭側妃提議藉此進行典廚比賽。殷紫萍得知太子妃心儀豆腐，故以豆腐入饌，希望得到太子妃賞識。

programme.title: 我係小廚神粵
programme.desc: 今集9位小廚師將以三人團體形式轉戰農莊。三組先品嚐滋味農家菜，再加入獨特創意，炮製剛剛品嚐過的「三餸一湯」，今次最高分一組全隊可順利出線；較低分的兩組則由評判選出表現強差人意的兩位淘汰出局！

programme.title: 萌馬吼吼S1

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 檢索愛情(完)
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 萌馬吼吼S1
programme.desc: 主人公吼吼，是一隻可愛的奶油獨角獸，他生活在甜蜜鎮上，這裡的居民都是各種甜品，有著各自的職業。作為一名快樂的打工人，吼吼每天都在小鎮的不同地方打工，當髮型師助理時，用自己的奶油為甜品們打造時下最流行的髮型，尤其是杯子蛋糕，對他的設計總是讚不絕口；吼吼還做過神奇的天氣安排員，尤其是想要喫糖的日子，更是少不了吼吼的精心安排，來一場美味的糖果雨，讓甜蜜在整個小鎮裡傳遞且讓吼吼的生活永遠不缺好玩的事。

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 冒險心星球
programme.desc: 在遙遠的夢幻星球「蒙斯蘭迪斯」，每個地區都代表著一種心情，有充滿愛心的「愛之海」，有會噴火發脾氣的「憤怒火山」，當小精靈心情不好，就會被送到島上進行大冒險！

programme.title: 檢索愛情(完)
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 極速悖論(完)
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap

The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu".

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Qing Shan Shi Gu Xiang - EP26

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Dialogue

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP24
programme.desc: We head to London to unveil the two newest inductee's into the Premier League Hall of fame. Hosted by Kelly Cates, and with a who's who of footballing royalty in attendance, we go behind the curtain to give you exclusive access to the hottest ticket in town.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP26
programme.desc: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the first of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Eden Hazard. A celebrated footballer who lit up the English top-flight during his illustrious career; a winner of multiple domestic and European honours, he became a true legend of the Premier League era. He reflects on his rise to the top, the moments that defined his career, and the immense pride he feels at joining the elite ranks of the Premier League's greatest ever players.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP27
programme.desc: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the second of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Gary Neville. From his journey from Class of '92 prodigy to Premier League Hall of Fame icon, he talks us through the moments that defined his legacy at Manchester United. A story on one of the league's most influential right-backs and a leader whose impact still shapes English football today.

programme.desc: We look back at all the goals and key action from a bumper Matchweek 20 in the Premier League, including City against Chelsea, Leeds v Man Utd, and leaders Arsenal's trip to Bournemouth.

programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP1
programme.desc: Once the unsung workhorses of English football, centre-backs have become some of the Premier League's most influential figures. This week, The Art of... sits down with two-time Premier League winner Joleon Lescott to explore how the role has evolved from last-ditch defending to a position that now shapes games, systems and titles. Joleon breaks down some of the key attributes of the role, and examines how the duties of the centre-back have expanded over time.

programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP2
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP2

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP9

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 20242025 (LIV)

There were also tactical transformations, shifts in narrative trends, and a more open field than ever before. Review of the Season documents all of the thrilling stories to emerge across the 380 matches.

With insight from icons on both sides-Ian Rush, Lou Macari, Brian Kidd, Michael Owen, Phil Thompson, and new Liverpool boss Arne Slot, we unpack the moments that have defined generations, split families, and lit up the Premier League.

programme.desc: The stone-walled dungeons of Fort Santiago, in Manila, were once witnesses of the most gruesome events in Philippine history.

programme.title: City Breaks - Salzburg
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici explores the Baroque splendor and musical heritage of Salzburg, the cultural capital of Austria.

programme.title: See My Home California - Yosemite
programme.desc: Join Genevieve on a scenic journey to Yosemite, with a charming detour through Carmel-by-the-Sea.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Majdanpek, Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Serbia’s largest national park, the Djerdap National Park, where she finds herself transfixed with the astounding Iron Gates gorge.

programme.title: 50 States Tennessee - Nashville
programme.desc: Nashville doesn’t ask Iona if she likes music. It just starts playing.

programme.title: Unbound - Piran, Slovenia
programme.desc: In Piran and Portoroz, two beautiful towns on the Slovenian Riviera, Sabrina peels back the layers of the country’s rich heritage.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP13
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP8
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP16
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP13
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Conquest - EP5
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.
